mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_logs ( user_id, login_type, login_method, session_id, ip_address, location, user_agent, success, failure_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{loginType}, #{loginMethod}, #{sessionId}, #{ipAddress}, #{location}, #{userAgent}, #{success}, #{failureReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ul.id, ul.user_id, u.name as user_name, u.role as user_role, ul.login_type, ul.login_method, ul.session_id, ul.ip_address, ul.location, ul.user_agent, ul.success, ul.failure_reason, ul.created_at FROM user_logs ul LEFT JOIN users u ON ul.user_id = u.id WHERE ul.id = #{id}

SELECT ul.id, ul.user_id, u.name as user_name, u.role as user_role, ul.login_type, ul.login_method, ul.session_id, ul.ip_address, ul.location, ul.user_agent, ul.success, ul.failure_reason, ul.created_at FROM user_logs ul LEFT JOIN users u ON ul.user_id = u.id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ul.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ul1.id, ul1.user_id, u.name as user_name, u.role as user_role, ul1.login_type, ul1.login_method, ul1.session_id, ul1.ip_address, ul1.location, ul1.user_agent, ul1.success, ul1.failure_reason, ul1.created_at FROM user_logs ul1 LEFT JOIN users u ON ul1.user_id = u.id WHERE ul1.login_type = 'LOGIN' AND ul1.success = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_logs ul2 WHERE ul2.user_id = ul1.user_id AND ul2.login_type = 'LOGOUT' AND ul2.created_at > ul1.created_at ) ORDER BY ul1.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ul.id, ul.user_id, u.name as user_name, u.role as user_role, ul.login_type, ul.login_method, ul.session_id, ul.ip_address, ul.location, ul.user_agent, ul.success, ul.failure_reason, ul.created_at FROM user_logs ul LEFT JOIN users u ON ul.user_id = u.id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId} AND ul.login_type IN ('LOGIN', 'LOGOUT') ORDER BY ul.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_logs WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
